<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const yearSelect = document.getElementById('media-year-filter');
  const keywordInput = document.getElementById('media-keyword-filter');
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('.media-item');

  function applyMediaFilters() {
    const yearVal = yearSelect.value;
    const minYear = yearVal === 'all' ? null : parseInt(yearVal, 10);
    const keyword = keywordInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();

    items.forEach(item => {
      const itemYear = parseInt(item.dataset.year, 10);
      const text = item.textContent.toLowerCase();
      let visible = true;

      if (minYear !== null && (!itemYear || itemYear < minYear)) {
        visible = false;
      }
      if (keyword && !text.includes(keyword)) {
        visible = false;
      }

      item.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';
    });
  }

  yearSelect.addEventListener('change', applyMediaFilters);
  keywordInput.addEventListener('input', applyMediaFilters);
});
</script>
